title: DAY 3 — LESSON 7: APPROPRIATE COMMUNICATION IN STAFF WHATSAPP GROUPS

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of a staff WhatsApp group?
options: Sharing unrelated entertainment throughout the day
Supporting relevant workplace communication and coordination

questions.prompt: A supervisor posts an important instruction. What should an employee do?
options: Read it carefully, clarify unclear details and acknowledge when required
Assume someone else will handle it

questions.prompt: Two employees begin arguing in the staff group. What is the most professional response?
options: Encourage other employees to take sides
Move the sensitive disagreement to an appropriate private discussion or supervisor
Please, can we confirm who is responsible for preparing Room 2 before the next appointment?
Nobody here knows what they're doing.

questions.prompt: What does the THINK method encourage?
options: Checking that messages are true, helpful, important, necessary and kind
Sharing every concern with the entire group
